stock.title: Mystery over source of Ebola infection in Nigeria fuels concern about spread of virus
stock.body: <p>Switzerland says patient is wife of Swiss diplomat and believed to have contracted virus while travelling in Uganda</p><p>Health officials across Africa are racing to determine how Nigeria’s first Ebola patient ⁠in more than a decade ⁠became infected, amid fears ​the outbreak could spread further after reaching a fourth African country.</p><p>The Swiss foreign ministry said on Friday the patient in Nigeria, the Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat based in Abuja, had not travelled to the Democratic Republic of ⁠Congo, where the outbreak was first detected in mid-May before spreading to Uganda, Kenya and now Nigeria. The woman was believed to have contracted Ebola while travelling with her husband in Uganda, the ministry added.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/23/ebola-swiss-patient-nigeria-dr-congo-concerns-virus-spread">Continue reading...</a>

stock.title: Lewis Hamilton aims to extend career till early 2030s so he can race in African Grand Prix
stock.body: <ul><li><p>41-year-old set on ‘dream to be able to race in Africa’</p></li><li><p>Rwanda to host despite criticism of human rights record</p></li></ul><p>Lewis Hamilton has said he hopes to remain racing in Formula One until he can take part in the African Grand Prix which is <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2026/oct/13/f1-returns-to-africa-for-first-time-since-1993-with-10-year-rwanda-deal-from-early-2030s">set to take place in Rwanda in the 2030s</a>. The seven-time world champion believes it is right that F1 is to hold a race there despite criticism of the country’s human rights record.</p><p>Last week F1 confirmed Rwanda was to host the African Grand Prix having concluded a 10-year agreement for the meeting on a purpose-built circuit, with the first race set for the early 2030s. It is lined up to be held on a circuit in Bugesera, 25 miles south of the capital, Kigali, which has yet to be constructed and marks a return to the African continent for the first time since it last held a race at Kyalami, South Africa in 1993.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2026/oct/22/lewis-hamilton-aims-to-extend-career-till-early-2030s-so-he-can-race-in-african-grand-prix">Continue reading...</a>

stock.title: US grants deportation reprieve to migrants from Ukraine and Sudan
stock.body: <p>DHS says migrants ‘retain protections’ after temporary protected status was set to expire on Monday</p><ul><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/oct/15/immigration-trump-midterms-reader-q-a">Send us your questions about immigration and the midterms</a></p></li></ul><p>More than 100,000 people from Ukraine and Sudan can stay in the United States without immediate risk of deportation, the Department of Homeland Security said, in what amounts to a temporary reprieve after their right to stay in the country was set to expire on Monday.</p><p>Temporary protected status was set to end on Monday for about 101,000 Ukrainians and 1,800 Sudanese. stock.title: LGBTQ+ people go into hiding in Senegal as hundreds are arrested
stock.body: <p>At least 320 people detained for ‘acts against nature’ after law criminalising homosexuality toughened, HRW reports</p><p>Mass arrests, forced HIV testing and barriers to legal representation are part of an escalating crackdown against LGBTQ+ people in Senegal, according to a <a href="https://www.hrw.org/news/2026/10/12/senegal-brutal-crackdown-violates-lgbt-peoples-rights">new report</a>.</p><p>More than 320 individuals have been arrested and detained on allegations of “acts against nature” since February, <a href="https://www.hivjustice.net/cases/senegal-crackdown-on-lgbtq-people-intensifies-with-multiple-arrests/">according to HIV Justice Network</a>, an organisation quoted in the Human Rights Watch (HRW) report. Among these, at least 84 were charged with “voluntary HIV transmission”, solely on the basis of their HIV status.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2026/oct/15/senegal-homosexuality-criminalised-anti-lgbtq-arrests-hiv-testing-human-rights-watch">Continue reading...</a>

stock.title: Guinea-Bissau denies it has approved controversial vaccine trial in newborns
stock.body: <p>Health minister says government ‘did not authorize’ Danish-led hepatitis B trial in babies backed by RFK Jr</p><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/guinea-bissau">Guinea-Bissau</a> has not approved the controversial <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/society/hepatitis-b">hepatitis B</a> study in newborns that would be funded by the US government and private partners, the African country’s minister of health said on Tuesday.</p><p>The study, which would not investigate the safety or effectiveness of vaccines but would instead track “nonspecific” health outcomes like overall mortality or neurodevelopmental conditions, has been championed by Robert F Kennedy Jr, secretary of the US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) and a longtime anti-vaccine activist.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/14/guinea-bissau-vaccine-hepatitis-b-trial-denial">Continue reading...</a>

items.title: オープンAI 開発一時中断 AIみずからサイバー攻撃実行のおそれ
items.summary: アメリカのオープンAIは、生成AI「ChatGPT」の関連モデル「アストラ」の開発を一時停止すると発表しました。開発中断の理由は、AIの性能向上により、自律的に重大なサイバー攻撃を行うリスクが否定できないためとされています。

karta.phrase: やるんかい やらんのやったら どいとれや

items.commentary: AIの力が強まる中で、無理に進めてリスクを抱えるより、一歩引いて見極める判断も必要や。仕事には役割と節度があって、焦らず慎重に動くことで信頼が積もる。けど、怖がってばかりやと、せっかくのチャンスを逃すことにもなる。せやから、どこで踏み込むか見極める目を持ち続けることが大事やで。

items.title: 「なりすまし広告」詐欺対策強化を 政府がSNS事業者に要請
items.summary: 政府は、SNS上で有名人の画像を無断使用した「なりすまし広告」による詐欺被害が増加していることを受け、SNS運営事業者に対して広告主の本人確認などの対策強化を求める文書を送付しました。

karta.phrase: つまらない 話もコトも しなさんな

items.commentary: SNSでのなりすまし広告対策、政府の要請は一歩やけど、表面だけの対応に終わらんようにせなあかん。あきんどの心やったら、無意味なやりとりや無責任な広告は避け、本気で信頼築くことに集中する。無駄なことに首突っ込まず、誠実な関係づくりを日々大事にせな、継続できへんで。

items.title: イオンネクスト／八王子CFC、自動化で冷凍エリアの入荷処理を2.7倍に
items.summary: イオンネクストは10月22日、東京都八王子市に新たな物流拠点「八王子CFC」を開設し、稼働を開始した。同施設では自動化技術を導入し、特に冷凍エリアの入荷処理能力を従来の約2.7倍に向上させている。今後、配送体制の強化も見込まれている。

karta.phrase: 来世でも 同じ生き様 やりまっせ

items.commentary: 物流の自動化で効率が上がるんは確かやけど、一過性の成果に浮かれるんやなく、日々の積み重ねが信頼を作るわけや。今の取り組みを続け、変わりゆく環境に対応しながら、ぶれん生き様を維持していくことが肝心やね。未来も見据えて地道にやり続ける覚悟が問われとるで。

items.title: 佐川急便／個人情報流出最大5323万件、第5報で「お荷物問い合わせ」再開
items.summary: 佐川急便は10月23日、「お荷物問い合わせサービス」を再開し、個人情報流出に関する第5報を発表した。今年9月30日に同社のサービスが第三者による不正アクセスを受け、最大5,323万件の個人情報が流出した可能性があると報告している。引き続き調査を進めているという。

karta.phrase: 商売人 仕事憎んで 人憎まず

items.commentary: 今回の件は情報管理の不備が招いたもんやけど、関係者を責めるだけやのうて、どう仕組みを改善して信頼を取り戻すかが問われる局面や。商売は人の繋がりが命やから、問題の根っこを冷静に見極めて、次に生かす姿勢が肝心やで。焦らずに着実に歩むことが信頼の積み重ねにつながるんや。

items.title: Mystery over source of Ebola infection in Nigeria fuels concern about spread of virus
items.summary: ナイジェリアで10年以上ぶりに確認されたエボラ感染者の感染経路をめぐり、保健当局が調査を進めている。感染者はナイジェリアのスイス大使の妻で、コンゴ民主共和国には渡航歴がなく、ウガンダ滞在中に感染したと見られている。エボラはこれまでにコンゴ民主共和国、ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアの4カ国に広がっている。

karta.phrase: 迷ったら もっかい一から やり直し

items.commentary: 感染経路が不明な時こそ、慌てず原点に立ち返る姿勢が肝心や。表面的な情報に流されず、基本から検証を重ねて信頼を築くことが、長い目で見た安心と持続につながるんや。焦らず一歩ずつやり直す心構えが、社会との関係性を深めるあきんどの道やで。
